title: Mixed Event — First Star After the Rain

meta.Outline: Saki has formed a band with her childhood friends and is enjoying what each day brings. She happens upon a poster for an observatory event one day and decides to plan a visit with her bandmates, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ngh...
Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I didn't realize I fell asleep. Ugh, my neck hurts. I must have slept in a weird position.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's raining again... I'm fed up with rain.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I hope the weather's nicer when my family comes to visit.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If it doesn't clear up, I won't see the stars tonight, either.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wonder how everyone's doing. I wonder if they're having fun with their classmates...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I miss them so much...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ngh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh?
This isn't a hospital bed...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
I'm all better now!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I can see everyone again...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Saki! Are you not ready yet?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: It's good that you've been putting so much effort into getting ready for the day each morning, but if you take too long, you'll be late!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What? It's morning?
Wh-What time is it?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh no... I overslept!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
I... I made it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That was close. If Tsukasa didn't wake me up, I definitely would've been late for classes.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Morning, Saki.
Glad you made it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're not the type to oversleep in the mornings, so I was surprised when you messaged me. Did you stay up too late?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, but I guess I was so caught up in my dream that I couldn't wake up.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What sort of dream?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well... It was, um...

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line:
Tenma, Hoshino...
The teacher's coming.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
Thanks for the heads up!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Come on, Ichi! We should return to our seats!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, right.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (She'd feel bad if I told her that I was dreaming about when I was in the hospital.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (The hospital was too far for her to visit me often and I think it made her feel guilty.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I don't want to cause my friends any more worries now that I've gotten better.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Let's make the most of this day!)
After school

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay, time to close the textbooks and head off to practice!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah.
You're really hyped today, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I guess so! I almost started off by running late today, but it's all good now!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Besides, we're meeting in you-know-where today!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's right. It's been a while since we last went, so I'm looking forward to it too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hi, Saki. Hi, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Honami! You made it through the day, so...
Lemme give you a hug!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Aaah! Careful, Saki.
You almost made me fall over...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't cause a scene in the corridor.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho! Don't you worry, I've got a hug for you too! Come here!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, cut it out. We've got important plans today, so let's find somewhere more private.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho, maybe you shouldn't be pinching Saki's cheeks like that. Her face just looks... Hehehe.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Haha! Saki, you should see yourself!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I pwomise I won't twy to hug you anymwore, fo let gwo of my sheeks!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Looks like no one's around.
Are you all ready?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay... Here we go!
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome back!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. We've been waiting for you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Miku! Luka!
Thanks for having us!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Always happy to.
I see you're full of pep as always, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And yet, this morning she surprised us by almost turning up late for classes.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
What, really?
That's pretty unusual.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You always come to school so early.
Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe... I fell back asleep right after waking up.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Haha, THAT is just like you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyways, enough about that. I can't wait to show the fruits of our labor to Miku and Luka!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, let's get ready to play.

rows.Speaker: Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (That dream really startled me, but I'm fine now.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(I'm no longer all alone.
I'm with my friends.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I have to make up for the time I lost from here on out!)
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay, I need to go to work now!
See you tomorrow♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You're working at the cafe today, right?
Take care.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Good luck with work, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Bye!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She was even more hyper than usual today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Maybe something nice happened to put her in a good mood? Like having her favorite food for dinner...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She'd have told us. She's just like a little kid, bragging about having a delicious Salisbury steak.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But if that's not it, what could it be?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, what could it be?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, whatever it is, it's good that she's happy.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm heading to the music store.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm going to do some shopping too.
See you later, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Maybe Saki was so energetic because she enjoys hanging out with us?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you so much for coming all this way to see me, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If anything, I owe you an apology for not visiting more often.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Don't be silly! It's a two-hour journey for you even by bullet train. It must be super expensive.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'd feel really bad if you had to make this long journey again and again.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wish I could see Hona and Shiho too, but it's understandable that they couldn't make it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll just have to put all my energy into getting better, so that we can hang out together again!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
...
Yeah. We'll be waiting for you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll be going now. See you later.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, see you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, by the way! I recommend the Peach Doll cookies that are sold at the station! They're really good and make great little gifts!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Bye, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She just wanted to be back with all of us so much.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm really happy we have our band going now.)
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: All done for today!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Thank you, Ms. Tenma. Have you written down which shifts you can take next month? The deadline's soon so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
There, done!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
The same as this month?
Got it. Okay, take care now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you. You too!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe, my planner's loaded♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've got band stuff, club activities and plenty of work... I'm living my life to the fullest!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I miss them so much...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want to spend more time with them...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hm, a new poster?
They must have put it up today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “The astronomical observatory is now open to the public... Witness the wonders of the night sky with your family and friends.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This is it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We could stargaze together!
Teenage life doesn't get dreamier than this!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: SEKAI has all those pretty stars, but I'd like to see the night sky in the real world too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So where's this observatory...? Ah! It's near the station on that trendy street nearby!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We could go shopping around noon, have lunch... It's the perfect opportunity to check out the bakery I read about in that magazine!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And there's also that art gallery I wanted to go to. Hmm, are we gonna have enough time for all that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We'll HAVE to find the time! It's going to be a day filled with memorable experiences!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Stargazing at the observatory at the end of that awesome day out will be the icing on the cake!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It's going to be so much fun!
Okay, time to organize this!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want to do as much as I can with them...!
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The observatory?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah! Let's all go next Saturday!
You normally don't get to go inside, you know!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I heard about it too!
It's usually closed to the public.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They're doing an open lecture about stars, so I was thinking about going myself!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I expect no less from you, Honami, our resident star expert!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You're exaggerating...
Besides, that place is quite famous.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's very interesting. A place where you can see the stars and learn about them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can imagine that knowing more about stars makes gazing at them even more enjoyable.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You don't need to go to an observatory to see the stars. They even look prettier here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Th-That's a true... But I thought it'd be nice if we could all go together for a change.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We could also go to a cafe, check out clothing stores, a karaoke place...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is that the main reason you want to go?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um... Those are just some other fun things we could do...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hona...!
Shiho's being mean to me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There, there. No need to get upset.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are you not interested in going to the observatory, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's not that. I just think it's not worth the trip is all.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That time would be better spent on more band practice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You're so down to earth, Shiho.
Or down to play bass, I suppose.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is that supposed to be funny?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sometimes the things you come out with are kind of bizarre, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Bizarre...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki, don't add fuel to the fire!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you just want to hang out, we can do that close to our station. There's no need to—

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's important to be in sync with each other if you're going to make good music as a team.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's important to connect through things other than music every now and then. It can only help you as a band.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho... You really don't want to go?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sigh...
Give me a moment to think it over.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I have work on that day, so I'll have to swap my shift with someone else.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So you'll come?
Yay!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Stop being so clingy.
I get enough of that from my sister...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sounds like you've persuaded her, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I only gave Shiho a little nudge in the direction she was already leaning towards.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's just one condition. Don't start slacking off with band practice because of this trip.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If I see you start to get lazy, I'm out. Got it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No worries! I'll practice diligently every day!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Every day? But you also have soft tennis club and your part-time job... Won't that be too much?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'll be fine!
I'm not how I used to be!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You say that now, but you caught a bad cold that kept you in bed for a whole week after pushing yourself too hard that one time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I can manage!
Stop worrying so much, you two!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nothing's going to stop me from enjoying my wonderful teenage life♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, of course.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's have a wonderful time, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
No, not really.
It's nothing, really.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That only makes me more curious. What is it?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's just that... Saki seemed a little different today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The tone of her voice told me that she was straining herself.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Her voice sounded strained...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That means... I don't want that to happen again...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thank you, Luka.
I'll make sure to look after Saki.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Please do.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho, let's get started with band practice!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright. Saki, it's good to be enthusiastic, but don't push yourself past your limits, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, I'm not a little kid or anything...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I can play our songs perfectly now, you know!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really? Okay, let's make a bet. If you make a mistake, you've got to buy me ramen.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It shouldn't be a problem if you're so confident, right? And if you play everything without slipping up, I'll treat you to bubble tea. Toppings and all, so it's a level price.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Your treat?
I'm going to win this bet for sure!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A-Are you okay, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: When you think about it, it makes no sense! Why on earth does ramen cost the same as bubble tea?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: When you think of the cost of the ingredients, it just doesn't add up... Right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You started shouting all of a sudden and we thought...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh? I-I'm sorry!
It just hit me and...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hahaha!
You made us all jump!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Sorry!
L-Let's start practicing!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! Let's start from just before the chorus. Get ready!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
They seem to be having fun...
Are you still worried, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A little.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Maybe I'm overthinking it...
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hmmhmm♪
Hehe♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which one should I wear...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Saki, can I come in?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sure♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I just wanted to ask... Whoa, why are your clothes all over the place? Are you starting a fashion show or something?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I'm just picking out what to wear for a date.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: D-Date?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: D-D-Date?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Of course...!
You're not a little girl anymore....!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whatever you do, you'll have my full support. Follow your heart!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What? Tsukasa, hold on!
Why are you giving me a “dad speech”?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm just going out with Ichi and the others!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
With Ichika and...?
Oh, your bandmates...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Was there something you wanted to ask me?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it's about your plans for the next weekend. Everyone else is going to be away on a trip.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm doing a show then, so I won't be home either. I was worried about leaving you all alone in case something happened.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, you don't have to worry because I'm going out with my bandmates on Saturday!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Great, so you'll have company.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
And anyway, you worry too much!
The doctor said I was fine.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's true, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I AM FINE!
You can go out and enjoy your weekend without being so concerned about me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, I got it. Just... Remember to look both ways before you cross the road!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I will!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa, you're such a worrywart.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... It'd be terrible if I came down with something before then...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: As much as I enjoy my club and my job, I should take it easy. I'll go to bed early tonight.
After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Soft Tennis Club Captain
rows.Line: Okay, team. Good work today!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you! See you next time!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hi, Saki. Is the soft tennis club done for the day?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah. The home ec club too?
Let's walk home together!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sure!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So in the end, I decided I'll wear the shorts I bought the other day and pair them with...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki, your face looks really flushed.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What? Really?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I don't feel like I'm running a fever.
Maybe I applied too much blush?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't think that's it... Just to be safe, maybe you should check your temperature when you get back home.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I'll do that. Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I'm sure it's nothing! My normal temperature's naturally a little higher than average.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (What if I do have a fever? Now that I think about it, I have been feeling a little out of it.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (No matter. A good night's sleep will make it go away.)
After school the next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oof...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I had a fever, like Hona said. I better head home early and make sure I get plenty of rest.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hm? It's from my boss...?
“Can anyone cover these shifts?”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I thought next month's schedule wouldn't be up for a while. Why are they already looking to cover shifts?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “Our part-time staff leader, Ms. Yamada, said her child caught the flu and urgently needs to take a week off from work.” Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “Please let me know ASAP if you can take any of her shifts.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It looks like they're struggling with finding someone to cover Saturday, but that's the day we're going to the observatory...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, I'm busy on that day...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: H-Hello, this is Saki speaking.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: “I'm sorry about the sudden call. Have you seen my message? Ms. Yamada's not coming in this week. Could you cover her shift on Saturday?”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but I can't do Saturday...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: “What about today? I've got someone who can take the Saturday shift if you can swap with them today.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'll probably be okay if I make sure to pace myself. They really need my help.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes, I think I can make it today!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
“Really?! Thank you!
You're a life-saver!”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll head over now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hey, Saki. You don't have club activities today, so you're going straight home, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sorry, Ichi! I have to cover someone's shift at the cafe. I've got to run or I won't make it. Bye!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I have to hurry...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Where's she running off to?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'll have to remind her again to take it easy...
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Sigh... I really have no luck today.
Why did it have to be so busy at work?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I think my fever's gotten a little worse...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Maybe I should cancel band practice tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's just one condition. Don't start slacking off with band practice because of this trip.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If I see you start to get lazy, I'm out. Got it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If I don't go, our trip to the observatory might get canceled, too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I have to buckle down and somehow hang on until Saturday.
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's make it an awesome session!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Saki, do you still have a fever?
You're a bit flushed today too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Huh? You have a fever, Saki?
Why didn't you stay home?

rows.Speaker: Saki

rows.Line:

rows.Line:
...

rows.Speaker: Shiho

rows.Line: It's like that time when you fainted...

rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Line: Why, Saki? Why didn't you say anything?!

rows.Line: How many times did I tell you to take it easy? Why do you always do this?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Why?

rows.Line:
It's because...
I really want to go to the observatory with you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
We can go whenever!
Your health is more important...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, we can't!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We can't go whenever!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, see you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ugh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Saki, are you okay?
Ichika, can you bring that chair over there?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Sit down, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay... Thanks...

rows.Line: I'm thinking of walking Saki home once she feels a little better, if that's okay with you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do that.
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You should be okay now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry for barging into your house and bossing you around...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No need to apologize. There's no one else in, and you helped me a lot. Thanks, Hona.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're quick to take charge and always know what to do in situations like this. It's pretty amazing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I have a younger brother, so I'm used to it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm sorry for causing you trouble again.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't say that...!

rows.Line:
It's not that, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...
Saturday

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's raining...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: My fever's pretty much gone...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But there's no point in going to the observatory now. We wouldn't be able to see anything with this weather.

rows.Line: Saki, breakfast is ready. There's even that hot chocolate you like. Why not come down?

rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Line: (He took a day off from his job to look after me.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'm burdening him with this too...)

rows.Line: Sorry, I don't feel like eating right now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: No? Well, if you get hungry, come downstairs and I'll fix up something for you anytime.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I miss them so much...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm such an idiot...

rows.Line: I get to be with everyone, so I should be happy...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I wanted to see the stars so much...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Did my phone just...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...
If I go over there, I can see the stars.
School SEKAI

rows.Line: Hello...

rows.Line:
There's nobody here...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nobody here either.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Where did everyone go?

rows.Line: I ended up alone again...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh!

You're wearing PJs today?

rows.Line: Um, there's a reason for this...!

rows.Line: Haha, well...

rows.Line: You can read me like a book...

rows.Line:

rows.Line: But I could see that you weren't your usual self.

rows.Line: Would you like to tell me what's wrong?

rows.Line: So you see, it's all my fault...

rows.Line: I insisted on going to the observatory together, but then I became careless and caught a cold. In the end, I just became a bother to everyone...

rows.Line: Why did you push yourself like that, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've been wanting to spend a day out with my friends like that for such a long time.
Neighborhood

rows.Line: Saki hasn't replied...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's nice to go and visit, but what if she has gotten worse and is still cooped up in bed?

rows.Line: Then we'll just pop in to say hi and leave her to rest.

rows.Line: I think she's feeling very lonely today.

rows.Line: Why do you say that?

rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Her mom said they took her there to see a famous doctor specializing in her condition.

rows.Line: I went to visit her several times after that with her mom.

rows.Line: And I remember during one of our conversations...

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Line: Thanks! Now, where did I put my stationery...? Here!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
“...and please take care.”
There, done!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I should write to Hona and Shiho too!
Letters feel much more personal than texts.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They seem so busy lately, and haven't been replying to my messages as much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah... They have a lot going on.
Maybe we can visit you together soon.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But that's not very likely...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe... I'll draw pictures of them, too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, no...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I was just thinking...
You get to go home and see everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wish I could see them, too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Haha, gotcha!
I can't let this rain get me down...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
“...don't forget to write back!”
There, finished!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona might write back, but I wonder if Shiho will bother? Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, here you go. Thank you for doing this!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No problem...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Poor Saki...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She must have been much lonelier than we realized.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So I think she'd be happy if we visited her together now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Aha! It's you guys!
Which means you're here to check on Saki?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yes, that's right...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Great! I'll be in my room planning a new show, so don't mind me and go right upstairs to Saki's room.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, I've just come up with an idea that'll make my show a huge success! I really am a genius!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And once it's ready for the stage, you're of course welcome to come see it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Haha... We'll make sure to.

rows.Line: Saki's brother hasn't changed at all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho, let's keep that to ourselves.

rows.Line: I also need to thank you for walking Saki home yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You're such great friends to her.
Thank you for always being there for her.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You're such a caring brother.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki's in her room. She was awake a little while ago, so I'm sure she'll be happy to talk to you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, we're all here to visit you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Saki? Maybe she has nodded off?
Saki, it's us.

rows.Line: But she wouldn't be able to see anything with this weather...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: My stay at the hospital wasn't easy, but there were some good moments.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The doctors and the other patients were very kind to me, and taught me how to juggle and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But sometimes I felt really lonely.
I'd look at the stars to feel better...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Because it reminded you of the times when you saw them with your friends?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Where did Luka go...?
I've looked everywhere for her...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, there she is.
She's with...? Saki?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(Saki looks so sad.
Maybe Luka is trying to cheer her up.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I should leave the two of them to talk.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Believing that I could stargaze with them again once I got better helped me get through some really awful medical tests.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But sometimes anxiety would suddenly overwhelm me sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: How do I describe it...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was scared that I was losing so much...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
What do you mean?
Losing so much...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The time I have to be with my friends...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Time...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I kept thinking, we should be having classes together instead of this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Or that I should be having fun on that school trip with them, chatting and staying up late.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I should've been with them, but the clock was ticking away while I was in the hospital, unable to do anything...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I felt like it was all being taken away from me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I felt the same way even about the time I'd already spent with them...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I felt... So scared...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's why I'm doing everything I can to make sure every moment matters.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I decided I won't let the time I should be spending with my friends slip away.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it only led to me pushing myself too hard, worrying everyone and...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm... I'm such an really idiot...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You couldn't help but be anxious...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You wanted to get back what you lost.
That seems perfectly normal.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You felt that all those things couldn't wait.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But you don't need to be in such a hurry to make up for that time. It's okay to take it easy.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's what I sensed.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I think your friends would agree too.
Wouldn't you? Ichika, Honami, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whaaat? When did you all get here?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We came to visit you, but you weren't in your room. Ichika correctly guessed you were here.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What are you doing out of bed, you dummy?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I-I'm so...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, I'm sorry.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
For being so harsh towards you.
For saying some really mean things.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You getting sick and being cooped up in bed the other time was also my fault since I pressed you to do more than you could handle.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And I did it again, despite Luka warning me that you seemed a little out of it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm angry at myself for not being a better friend and noticing when something wasn't right. I even said some really mean things to you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm really sorry...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You don't need to apologize!
It's all my own...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, it's not your fault, Saki. I didn't realize what was going on with you either. I would've figured it out if I'd only given it some thought.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Hona...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You can take your time. We're going to spend lots of time together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It's like what Luka said.
There's no need to hurry.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're not going anywhere. We're always going to be together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But how's your cold, Saki? Walking around in your PJs might not be the best idea.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, right... My fever isn't completely gone yet, so I should probably go back.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sounds good. Let's reschedule our observatory trip for when it's next open to the public.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay. That's not going to be for a while, but I guess I'll just have to be patient...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hopefully the weather will be better then.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If only the skies were always clear in our world, like here.

rows.Line: Like here...

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Ngh... I'm getting... Sleepy...

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This planetarium, and playing in a band with Miku and Luka makes me so happy.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This time spent with you all has been so amazing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I hope we can keep doing things like this and make more great memories together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's the plan!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Everything will be okay now.
No more anxiety. No more being scared.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'll take my time and enjoy every day as it comes. Together, with my friends.)
